text: もっと　つよいの　さがして　こよう

structure.en: I'll go look for and come back

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands in for the thing itself, like 'one'. つよいの = 'a strong one'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb means going off to do it and coming back; こよう is its 'I think I will' form. さがして こよう = 'I'll go and look for one'.
